facts.text: Rosewood Doha is in Lusail, Qatar.
facts.excerpt: Rosewood DohaLusail, Qatar

facts.text: The hotel sits on the south-easterly tip of Lusail's Marina District.
facts.excerpt: On the south-easterly tip of its Marina District, the two towers of Rosewood Doha emerge, seemingly from the sea

facts.text: Lusail is a 30-minute drive from Hamad International Airport.
facts.excerpt: A 30-minute drive from Hamad International Airport delivers us to Lusail

facts.text: The hotel's two towers are encased in a white latticed facade inspired by the forms of a coral reef.
facts.excerpt: encased in a striking white latticed facade inspired by the forms of a coral reef

facts.text: The reception area features objects sourced from Souq Waqif, including brass-studded wooden dowry boxes.
facts.excerpt: many sourced from the winding alleys of Doha’s famed Souq Waqif, including brass-studded wooden boxes traditionally used to store a woman’s dowry

facts.text: Artworks by local creatives such as Yasser Al Mulla and Azzam Al Mannai hang on the walls.
facts.excerpt: artworks by local creatives such as Yasser Al Mulla and Azzam Al Mannai adorn walls

facts.text: Guests can take pottery classes with local architect and ceramicist Reema Abu Hassan at Clay Encounters.
facts.excerpt: pottery classes with local architect and ceramicist Reema Abu Hassan at the charming, sun-filled, sea-facing Clay Encounters

facts.text: The hotel offers lunch aboard a traditional dhow through Lusail's waterways.
facts.excerpt: Savor a leisurely lunch aboard a traditional dhow, drifting through Lusail’s serene waterways.

facts.text: The hotel offers an encounter with Qatar's art of falconry.
facts.excerpt: An encounter with Qatar’s revered art of falconry, guided by those who keep the tradition alive.

facts.text: The hotel offers a dinner under the stars in the desert.
facts.excerpt:
The Desert, Reimagined

A rare and intimate gathering over dinner under the stars, guided by the warmth of Qatari custom.

facts.text: Rosewood Doha has eight dining spaces.
facts.excerpt: Fire and spice shape eight dining spaces that unite the Gulf and global gastronomy

facts.text: Koo Madame serves Chinese food, including hand-pulled noodles and dim sum, in a space evoking 1920s Shanghai.
facts.excerpt: served in a space that transports guests to 1920s Shanghai

facts.text: Koo Madame's menu includes the Gongfu Cha tea ritual.
facts.excerpt: the menu spans the Gongfu Cha tea ritual

facts.text: Mila serves Levantine recipes on the Arabian Gulf shoreline.
facts.excerpt: Where time-honored Levantine recipes meet modern flair, Mila brings refined flavor and vibrancy to Doha’s Arabian Gulf shoreline.

facts.text: Stoke & Stoker pairs cocktails with Asian plates and crudo, overlooking the Gulf.
facts.excerpt: Where adventurous spirits meet refined mixology, paired with Asian plates and crudo, overlooking the Gulf.

facts.text: The Butterfly Room serves a traditional afternoon tea.
facts.excerpt: Indulge in a traditional Afternoon Tea experience with a selection of tantalising bites and classic nibbles complimented alongside sweet treats from the Butterfly Patisserie.

facts.text: The Butterfly Room's afternoon tea ends with a dedicated chocolate trolley.
facts.excerpt: a decadent afternoon tea bookended with a dedicated chocolate trolley

facts.text: Asaya Kitchen works with local farmers, purveyors and artisans.
facts.excerpt: Asaya Kitchen celebrates provenance through the work of local farmers, purveyors, and artisans.

facts.text: Junior Suites have Arabian Gulf or Lusail City views and a marble bathroom with a double rain shower.
facts.excerpt: Junior Suites feature Arabian Gulf or Lusail City views, a seating area, and a marble bathroom with a double rain shower

facts.text: The Reef Suite has a king bedroom, marble bath, living and dining spaces, and butler service.
facts.excerpt: the Reef Suite blends modern design with Qatari creativity, offering a king bedroom, marble bath, living and dining spaces, and butler service.

facts.text: One-Bedroom Residences have a fully equipped kitchen and an ensuite with a soaking tub.
facts.excerpt: Spacious One-Bedroom Residences offer elegant living, stunning Doha views, a fully equipped kitchen, and a serene ensuite with a soaking tub.

facts.text: Children are catered to through the Rosewood Explorers programme, with a kids pool, outdoor play area and indoor kids club.
facts.excerpt: Little ones are well catered to via the Rosewood Explorers programme. There’s a dedicated kids pool, outdoor play area and an indoor kids club

facts.text: A marina promenade runs in front of the hotel.
facts.excerpt: the marina promenade running in front of the Rosewood is filled with people strolling by the sea

facts.text: The members-only Asaya Social Wellness Club was due to be fully operational in September.
facts.excerpt: Once fully operational in September, the members-only Asaya Social Wellness Club will serve as one of Doha’s most holistic wellbeing facilities

facts.text: Rosewood Doha is Rosewood's third property in the Middle East, after Jeddah and Abu Dhabi.
facts.excerpt: Rosewood Doha is its third property in the Middle East, joining existing hotels in Jeddah and Abu Dhabi.

facts.text: Rosewood Doha was named to Conde Nast Traveler's Hot List 2026.
facts.excerpt: Hot List 2026
